integrity: A complete symbolic proof and exact finite corroboration are included. Infinite claims rely on the symbolic argument; no formal external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Odd prime p only; settles Rowland 2011 Conjecture 2, not Conjecture 1 or arbitrary pq. Earlier equivalent proofs outside the located literature are possible; independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: A binary digit proof of Rowland's second binomial-coefficient conjecture
